CHIEF COMPLAINT
Follow-up for chronic congestive heart failure with diastolic dysfunction prior to planned knee surgery.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Ms. Nicole Miller is a 76-year-old female with chronic CHF and diastolic dysfunction presenting for follow-up evaluation. She was previously experiencing increasing dyspnea with BNP levels of 3,000 in March that rose to 6,000 in April, prompting medication adjustments. Furosemide was changed to torsemide 20 mg daily, and lisinopril was increased to 10 mg daily in March. Patient is scheduled for right knee replacement surgery on June 24th and has been working to optimize cardiovascular status prior to the procedure. She reports weight loss of approximately 3 to 3.5 pounds since last visit in April with improved fluid management. She notes improvement in urinary urgency on current medications. She reports one episode of bilateral leg cramps several days ago attributed to being cold while sleeping, self-treated with pickle juice with complete resolution. She denies current leg or finger cramps. She had heartburn that worsened; she took Prilosec for approximately 2 weeks in January, then discontinued and has been symptom-free since. She is due for colonoscopy screening.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Positive for resolved leg cramps and resolved heartburn. Negative for current chest pain, dyspnea at rest, or palpitations. Urinary and bowel function normal.

1. Chronic congestive heart failure with diastolic dysfunction
2. History of anemia
3. Heartburn (resolved)

MEDICATIONS
1. Torsemide 20 mg daily
2. Lisinopril 10 mg daily
3. Clopidogrel (to be discontinued 1 week prior to surgery)

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN

1. Chronic Congestive Heart Failure with mixed presentation. Patient had exacerbation in spring. Successfully transitioned from furosemide to torsemide with significant symptomatic improvement including weight loss of 3 to 3.5 pounds and resolution of dyspnea. Breathing currently non-labored. Continue torsemide 20 mg daily and lisinopril 10 mg daily. Repeat EKG today. Labs checked and creatinine appropriate. Continue current regimen and close monitoring.

2. Pre-operative Evaluation for Right Knee Replacement. Surgery scheduled for June 24th. Discontinue clopidogrel 1 week prior to surgery. Complete pre-operative check within 2 weeks of surgery (first or second week of June). EKG to be repeated today. No chest X-ray needed. No additional blood work needed. Patient has written reminders for medication changes.

3. Colonoscopy. Patient overdue for screening colonoscopy. Refer to Bartley Regional Hospital for scheduling within next 30 days prior to insurance change. No family history of colon cancer. Completion should not delay surgery.

4. Diabetes. A1C was 5.1 on last check. Blood glucose 169 today (non-fasting). No A1C needed today but may repeat prior to surgery next month.

5. Magnesium Supplementation. Recommend adding magnesium supplement twice daily to target level of approximately 2.0 to help stabilize heart muscle. Patient agrees.
